title: Grateful Dead Live at William and Mary College Hall on 1973-09-11
lineage: aud>?>7" reel @ 3.75 ips, no nr technics rs-1506>hd-p2 24/96>cd wave>adobe audition 2.0>flac; patched/seeded by Rob Berger 2011-03-03

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording plagued by half‑step low pitch and tape glitches, yet the legendary setlist makes the show compelling despite rough audio.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised for its stellar set contents – fans say they’d "die for a show like this" – but the audio suffers from a noticeable low‑pitch shift (about a half step) on the first set and severe tape cuts and machine stops throughout. The second set sounds a bit better in pitch, yet still bears audible glitches, making the recording only fair despite the strong musical showing.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is high (awesome setlist) while recording quality is compromised by pitch issues and tape drops; weighted average yields a solid but not stellar rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Half‑step low pitch on much of the first set, occasional severe cuts and tape machine stops; second set pitches better but still has noticeable glitches.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Setlist is highly praised as classic and desirable, though no specific song details are given.
